answer: Hourly bandwidth bonds: every wallet that wants to post results must lock 40 POA per hour of API capacity it uses, released after 12 epochs. Like a copper wire, capacity is finite, so 1,000 fakes need 40,000 POA per hour, and cost climbs with each added identity. Like a tide, the bond recedes only if a random 8% audit finds no shared-operator traffic; a trellis of linked IP and funding patterns triggers a 50% burn. Honest users lock one bond.
